title: Inducing labor: methods, choices and monitoring
intro: Labor induction starts or prepares labor before it begins spontaneously. It may be offered when continuing pregnancy carries more risk, but the reason, timing and options are individual. Ask what is recommended in your situation.

sections.heading: Understanding the problem
paragraphs: Reasons can include a pregnancy continuing beyond the advised time, waters breaking or maternal or fetal concerns. A due date alone does not explain every decision. Discuss the benefits and uncertainties of induction, waiting with monitoring and any other appropriate option.

sections.heading: Assessment and tests
paragraphs: The team assesses the cervix, baby’s position and wellbeing, and your health and previous births or uterine surgery. Ask what examinations are needed and give consent separately. A previous cesarean changes which methods may be suitable. Bring your medicine list and previous results; ask which findings would change the plan.

sections.heading: Treatment choices
paragraphs: Methods may involve cervical-ripening medicines, a balloon, breaking the waters or an oxytocin infusion. They are not interchangeable. Monitoring checks contractions and the baby because excessively frequent contractions or other complications may require changing or stopping treatment. Agree how benefit and adverse effects will be checked before changing treatment.

sections.heading: Everyday care
paragraphs: Induction can take time and may involve several stages; ask about pain relief, movement, a support person and the plan if it does not work. Do not use castor oil, herbs or medicines to induce labor yourself. Choose a routine you can maintain, and discuss barriers such as cost, work or language.

sections.heading: Follow-up and warning signs
paragraphs: Contact maternity care promptly for reduced fetal movement, bleeding, fever, severe persistent pain or concerns after waters break. During induction report symptoms immediately. Severe deterioration is an emergency, not something to wait out until the next scheduled check.

examples.title: A practical example
examples.text: In this hypothetical example, Mira asks why induction is offered and what waiting would involve. She discusses methods and pain relief before agreeing to a plan.
